d2cb8fbf8cbdc07feb7f85f0b5beeb8be0a5ce58: Nendaz is one of the rare resorts offering more than 412 km of runs — a colossal area that even the fastest skiers won't cover in a week. Technical terrain is king at Nendaz: with 25 black runs and 49 red runs on offer, confirmed skiers will find plenty to challenge them. Off-piste and freeride are practised in often excellent conditions thanks to the altitude and the orientation of the slopes. Snow-wise, Nendaz is in a strong position with its highest point at 3330 m — even in capricious winters, the upper runs hold up well into April. The budget for a stay at Nendaz is clearly high: €99 for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps.
